tools.Name: CLI-Anything
tools.Description: A framework that transforms any software with a codebase into an agent-native tool through automated CLI generation.
tools.Use_Case: Enabling AI agents to control complex desktop and server software like GIMP, Blender, or LibreOffice via structured command-line interfaces.

tools.Name: Academic Research Skills (ARS)
tools.Description: A comprehensive suite of agents for Claude Code designed to manage the full academic research pipeline from planning to publication.
tools.Use_Case: Handling research grunt work like finding references, checking logical consistency, and peer-reviewing papers while keeping the human in the loop.

tools.Name: PPT Master
tools.Description: Generates natively editable PowerPoint (.pptx) presentations from documents using real PowerPoint shapes and native animations.
tools.Use_Case: Creating professional, fully editable presentations from PDFs, Markdown, or web content without flattening content into images.
